newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 6.84 million barrels in the week ended March 7 to 304.62 million barrels from 297.78 million in the prior week, American Petroleum Institute (API) said Wednesday.
API said crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 2.14 million barrels in the week to 238.29 million barrels from 236.15 million.
Distillate stocks rose 197,000 barrels to 106.89 million barrels from 106.69 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.34 million barrels to 39.08 million barrels from 37.74 million.
Gasoline production fell 137,000 barrels in the week to 7.24 million bpd from 7.38 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 668,000 barrels in the week to 202.49 million barrels from 201.82 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 89.5 percent from 88.6 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 618,000 barrels to 38.18 million barrels from 37.57 million barrels in the previous week.
Crude runs to processing units rose to 13.58 million barrels from 13.39 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 41.01 million barrels from 41.08 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.51 million barrels per day from 7.11 million, API said.
API normally issues its report on Tuesdays after 1600 Eastern time. This week's report was delayed until today due to technical problems.
